title: Seven Days of Waiting
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The enemies were marching close,
King Saul was so afraid.
And Samuel said, "Wait seven days,
Till I have come and prayed."

[Chorus]
Good things come to the ones who wait,
So be patient, my dear.
The Lord will always keep His word,
Just trust Him, He is near.

[Verse 2]
Day one, day two, the soldiers left,
And Saul could wait no more.
He made the gift to God himself,
Then Samuel reached the door.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the night is long,
But morning always comes.
Heavenly Father's by your side
While the soft nighttime hums.

[Chorus]
mood: Waiting music. A slow, patient pulse counts under the voice like days passing one at a time, never hurried, teaching the ear to wait. The first verses hold a low, steady tension that eases rather than builds, so the story feels thoughtful instead of frightening. By the last verse the counting slows and sinks lower, each beat a little farther apart, until waiting turns into resting.
